title: 第一章 易筋经大圆满第二章 图命
slug: 灭门夜我易筋经大圆满
content_zh:
拳头划破空气的呼啸之声，在院落之中接连响起。
少年打着赤膊，略显单薄的身体却爆发出极其惊人的力量。
就见他沉腰坐马，拳出如枪，将空气打的发出一声脆响。
拳风呼啸着撕裂空气，吹得院中绿植不住摇曳。
他眸中闪烁精光，缓缓吐出了一口气，脑海之中不禁浮现出了三个月前，师父郑四海对他说的话。
“书文，练武讲究的是资质和悟性。
“资质是筋骨皮，有些人天生骨架大，筋骨壮，这就是好资质。
“悟性是脑子好，聪明，能举一反三，稍微提点一下，就明白应该怎么练。
“你的悟性极好，为师收的这么多弟子之中，堪称第一。
“可你早年颠沛流离，致使身体根基有损，此生无望武功大成。
“到此为止吧，你大师兄给你引荐，让你去周家做护院武师。
“周家老爷周飞雄，人称周半城，家财万贯，做他家的护院武师，大富大贵太远，但至少衣食无忧。”
那一日，方书文走出郑四海的房间之后，脸上的笑容也满是苦涩。
他自觉自己大概是混的最惨的穿越者了。
穿越到这世上已经足足十九年。
刚出生那会还好，父母健在，还薄有家资。
哪里想到一次归乡省亲，遭遇了山匪袭击，他就此跟父母失散。
其后被一个老乞丐给捡到了，把他当成乞讨的工具，借此博取同情心。
得益于此，他没有饿死，讥一顿饱一顿的长到五六岁，老乞丐又不满足，想要将他的手脚打断，因为这样带着他上街乞讨就能得到更多的银子。
只可惜，老乞丐常年风餐露宿，体弱多病，想到未来的美好生活，一激动没等打断方书文的四肢，自己倒是先犯了羊癫疯。

方书文趁着他倒地不起，从他身上摸出了防身用的铁皮刀，在老乞丐不敢置信的眼神里，一刀抹了他的脖子。
自打这之后，他便一个人在街道上摸爬滚打。
作为穿越者，他会的，懂得，往往比旁人更多，凭借这一点，他其实可以过的比大多数人都要好。
可是有些事情他不能做，也不敢做。
当今之世，豪强遍地，江湖上高手如云，这些人高来高去，飞檐走壁，往往视人命如草芥。
他若是表现出了自己的不凡，在小小的年纪就有通天的手段赚取大量的财富，必然会被有心人看在眼里。
在没有自保之力的情况下，他什么都守不住，包括自己的命。
所以他只能和其他人一样，在街道上打滚，运气好了，能有一餐饭食，运气不好，饿个三天两日的都是常态。
更别说还得跟其他乞丐争抢，他年纪小，力气弱，不知道挨了多少顿毒打。
好几次险死还生。
他的根基便是在那个时候坏的。
磕磕绊绊的厮混到了**岁，他才找到了一个药铺打杂的营生，掌柜的可怜他年纪小，又喜欢他机灵嘴甜，不仅仅包了吃住，每个月还给他一点月钱。
一直到他十五岁，积攒够了足够的银子，这才辞别药铺掌柜，拜入了四海武馆，成为郑四海的徒弟，拥有了习武的资格。
这一学就是四年，结果就学来一句‘到此为止’。
他不甘心，他又岂能甘心？
他宛如野草一般野蛮生长，自有百折不挠的心性。
他一定得过的好，至少比大多数人要好，不敢说富可敌国，也得家财万贯。
武功是安身立命之本，事到如今他不敢求问鼎江湖，俯瞰天下。
但也得放眼四顾无人敢欺才行！
可当时摆在他面前，最大的难关还不是练武不成，而是他没钱了。

这四年靠着他节衣缩食勉强支撑，到了此时，已经是身无分文。
一分钱难倒英雄汉，他也不是没想过去寻找自己的亲生父母。
可问题是，以他如今的武功，一个人离开这座城池，那就跟自寻死路也没有任何区别了。
所以，不管他有什么样的野望和期许，都得暂时放一放。
听从大师兄的安排，借他引荐了周家一位门客，成为了这周家的护院武师。
content_en:
The whistling sounds of fists piercing the air resounded one after another in the courtyard.
The young man was shirtless, but his slightly thin body burst out with extremely amazing power.
He was seen sitting on his horse with his waist down, punching out like a gun, punching the air with a crisp sound.
The fist wind roared and tore through the air, causing the green plants in the courtyard to sway.
His eyes flashed and he slowly exhaled. What Master Zheng Sihai said to him three months ago could not help but come to mind.
“Shuwen and martial arts training focus on aptitude and understanding.
"Qualifications are muscles, bones and skin. Some people are born with big bones and strong muscles and bones. This is a good qualification.
“Comprehension means having a good mind, being smart, and being able to draw inferences from one instance to another. With a little bit of guidance, you will understand how to practice.
"You have an excellent understanding, and among the many disciples you have accepted as your master, you are ranked number one.
"But you have been wandering around in your early years, which has damaged your physical foundation. There is no hope of achieving great martial arts success in this life.
"That's it for now, your senior brother has recommended you to go to the Zhou family to be a martial arts guardian.
"The master of the Zhou family, Zhou Feixiong, is known as Zhou Bancheng. His family is extremely wealthy. He is the martial arts guardian of his family. It is too far to be rich and famous, but at least he has enough food and clothing."
That day, after Fang Shuwen walked out of Zheng Sihai's room, the smile on his face was full of bitterness.
He felt that he was probably the most miserable time traveler.
It has been nineteen years since I traveled to this world.
It was fine when I was just born. My parents were still alive and I had little financial resources.
Unexpectedly, when he returned to his hometown to visit relatives, he was attacked by bandits, and he was separated from his parents.
Later, he was picked up by an old beggar, who used him as a begging tool to gain sympathy.
Thanks to this, he did not starve to death and lived until he was five or six years old. The old beggar was not satisfied and wanted to break his hands and feet, because in this way he could get more money by taking him to the streets to beg.
It's a pity that the old beggar lived in the open all year round and was frail and sick. Thinking of the good life in the future, when he got excited, he fell into epilepsy before breaking Fang Shuwen's limbs.
While he was lying on the ground, Fang Shuwen took out the iron knife used for self-defense from his body, and with the old beggar's disbelieving eyes, he wiped his neck with the knife.
Since then, he has been crawling around the streets alone.
As a time traveler, he knows and understands more than others. With this, he can actually live better than most people.
But there are some things he can't do and doesn't dare to do.
In today's world, there are powerful people all over the world, and there are many masters in the world. These people come and go, fly over the walls, and often regard human life as nothing.
If he shows that he is extraordinary and has extraordinary means to earn a lot of wealth at a young age, he will definitely be noticed by those who are interested.
Without the ability to protect himself, he could not protect anything, including his own life.
So he could only roll around in the streets like everyone else. If he was lucky, he would have a meal. If he was not lucky, it would be normal for him to be hungry for three days and two.
Not to mention having to fight with other beggars. He was young and weak, so he received countless beatings.
I narrowly escaped death several times.
His foundation was broken at that time.
After stumbling around until he was 6 years old, he found a job as a busboy in a drug store. The shopkeeper felt pity for his young age and liked his clever and sweet mouth. Not only did he include room and board, but he also gave him a little monthly money.
It wasn't until he was fifteen years old and had accumulated enough money that he bid farewell to the medicine shop owner and joined the Sihai Martial Arts School, becoming Zheng Sihai's apprentice and possessing the qualifications to practice martial arts.
This study lasted four years, and in the end I learned the phrase "that's all."
If he is not willing to do so, how can he be willing to do so?
He grows wildly like a weed and has an indomitable character.
He must have a good life, at least better than most people. I dare not say that he is as rich as the country, but he also has a fortune.
Martial arts is the foundation of a life, but now he doesn't dareI want to be the leader of the world and have a bird's eye view of the world.
But you have to look around and see if no one dares to bully you!
But the biggest difficulty facing him at that time was not that he could not practice martial arts, but that he had no money.
In the past four years, he had been able to barely support himself by scrimping on food and clothing, and by this time, he was already penniless.
Even though a penny stumped the heroic man, it wasn't like he didn't think about finding his biological parents.
But the problem is, with his current martial arts skills, leaving this city alone is no different than seeking death.
Therefore, no matter what kind of ambitions and expectations he has, he has to put them aside for the time being.
Following the arrangement of the senior brother, he introduced a disciple of the Zhou family and became the martial arts guardian of the Zhou family.
